Run Standard ImprintomeSet Visualizations

Source: R/ImprintomeSet-visualizations.R
runImprintomeVisualizations.Rd

Generate a standard set of ImprintomeSet plots using the object-first plot() dispatcher. Successful plots can be stored in plots(x) and/or written to disk. Direct-draw plots, such as circular heatmaps, are captured as file-backed plot objects when possible.

Usage

runImprintomeVisualizations(
  x,
  plot_types = "default",
  probeset = "selected",
  result_name = NULL,
  sample_id = NULL,
  prefix = "imprintome",
  outdir = NULL,
  save_plots = FALSE,
  store_plots = TRUE,
  overwrite = TRUE,
  SAMPLEID = "Sample_Name",
  annoColumn = "Sample_Group",
  sectionColumn = "Sample_Group",
  colorColumn = "Sample_Group",
  rainfall_probeset = "selected",
  chr = NULL,
  plot_device = "pdf",
  verbose = TRUE,
  ...
)

Arguments

x

An ImprintomeSet object.

plot_types

Character vector of plot types. Use "default" for the standard workflow set, or "all" for all supported non-auto plot types. "icr_heatmap" draws PlotICRHeatmap() from the per-ICR table stored by runImprintome(icr = TRUE); "default" and "all" include it when that table is present.

probeset

Probeset name passed to plot backends.

result_name

Optional result table name for result-driven plots.

sample_id

Optional sample ID for sample-level plot types.

prefix

Filename prefix used when save_plots = TRUE.

outdir

Output directory used when save_plots = TRUE.

save_plots

Logical; write plot files while generating plots.

store_plots

Logical; store successful plot objects in plots(x).

overwrite

Logical; overwrite existing plot files.

SAMPLEID

Metadata column used for sample labels.

annoColumn

Metadata column used for heatmap annotation.

sectionColumn

Metadata column used for circular heatmap sections.

colorColumn

Result column used for polar plot colors.

rainfall_probeset

Probeset used for rainfall plots.

chr

Chromosome focus for beeswarm_chr; NULL uses all chromosomes.

plot_device

File extension for saved plots. Currently only "pdf" is supported because several plotting backends write PDF devices directly.

verbose

Logical; print progress messages.

...

Additional arguments passed to plot().

Value

The updated ImprintomeSet. A data.frame describing attempted plots is attached as attr(x, "visualization_manifest").

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
x <- runImprintomeVisualizations(x, prefix = "GSE240091")
names(plots(x))
} # }
